newsitem.title: USA: NHP says Insignia will offer $24 per shr.
newsitem.headline: NHP says Insignia will offer $24 per shr.

text.p: NHP Inc said Thursday Insignia Financial Group Inc has sent it a letter stating that it is prepared to offer $24 per share -- 50 percent cash and 50 percent in Insignia Class A common stock -- for all outstanding stock in NHP, including stock held by Demeter Holdings Corp and Capricorn Investors LP.

In the letter, the company said Insignia expects that the stock portion of the transaction would be tax-free to NHP shareholders. Insignia, said the company, also said it does not contemplate a spin- off of NHP's Washington Mortgage Financial Group subsidiary.
NHP said it is prepared to evaluate the terms, feasibility and likelihood of closing of any offers received, in light of the best interests of stockholders.
